title: SMOK M Replacement Pods 2ml - 3 Pods
description: The Smok Novo M Pods are designed to complement the Smok Novo GT Box Kit and other kits in the Novo collection, providing a seamless and flavourful vaping experience with zero fuss. With a 2ml e-liquid capacity, these pods feature a convenient top-fill design that ensures mess-free refills without the need to remove the pod from the device. Available in three resistances (0.6ohm, 0.8ohm, and 1.0ohm), the Novo M Pods allow you to tailor your vape to your preferences. The 0.6ohm pod is ideal for a warmer, more intense restricted direct lung (RDL) experience, while the 0.8ohm and 1.0ohm pods are perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vapers looking for a smooth and satisfying draw. Each pod is equipped with a built-in coil that ensures consistent vapour production and robust flavour, making them a great choice for vapers who prefer convenience without sacrificing quality. Simply fill the pod from the top, snap it into your Novo GT Box device, and enjoy a hassle-free vaping experience. We Recommend using High PG , 50/50 or Nic Salt with these pods: SMOK M Replacement Pods 1.0ohm - Use High PG or 50/50 SMOK M Replacement Pods 0.8ohm - Use 50/50 or Nic Salts E-Liquid SMOK M Replacement Pods 0.6ohm - Use 50/50 or Nic Salts E-Liquid Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
